name: State Rice Mission Scheme
briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to increase productivity and production of rice through improved technologies and extension methods and, to supply the quality/certified seeds/organic fertilizers at 50% subsidy.
descriptionMd: The “State Rice Mission Scheme” is a State Plan Scheme, which is implemented by the Department of Agriculture &amp; Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya. The objective of the scheme is to increase productivity and production of rice through improved technologies and extension methods and, to supply the quality/certified seeds/organic fertilizers at 50% subsidy.
benefitsMd:
> **Pattern of Assistance:**


- Training, Awareness program, extension, Technology support, Subsidy on inputs.

> **Type of Assistance and Entitlement (If any):**


1. 50 % Subsidy for quality paddy seeds to farmers.
1. Minor irrigation (Check dam, shallow tube well, etc.)
1. 50 % sale of Power Tillers SRI Tools for demonstration.
1. Trainings
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
applicationMd:
> **Application Process:**

**Step 01:** The eligible bonafide farmer can apply/write an application on plain paper.
**Step 02:** Along with the application, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 03:** Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the relevant documents at the nearest office of the Agriculture Development Officer of a CD Block/ Agriculture Circle.
> **Mode of Selection of Beneficiary(s):**

The bonafide farmers having sufficient available cultivable land shall be selected on a first come first served basis.
> **Whom to Contact:**


   1. District Agriculture Officers of the concerned districts.
   1. Sub-divisional Officers of the concerned sub-divisions.
   1. District Training Officers, Tura/Shillong.
   1. Agriculture Development Officers of the concerned Community and Rural Development Blocks.
